subject: Ops & Architecture — confirm engineer roster + two slot options
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moore <alice@orintech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Ops & Architecture — confirm engineer roster + two slot options

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for the discovery yesterday — appreciate the clarity on the throughput targets and regional constraints. We'd like to lock a focused technical deep-dive with our infra and serving engineers to:

- walk through a proposed topology for your multi-region inference needs (including routing/fallback),
- validate network topology and firewall requirements for private deployments, and
- review expected load patterns so we can sketch batching/caching recommendations.

Agenda (30–45m):
1) quick recap (5m)
2) proposed serving topology + latency tradeoffs (15m)
3) network/security checklist + ports (10m)
4) next steps / action items (5–15m)

Two slot options (PT):
- Option A: Tue Nov 16, 11:00–11:45 AM PT
- Option B: Wed Nov 17, 8:00–8:45 AM PT

Please confirm which works best for your engineering team, and who from OrinTech would join (we recommend the person who owns the VPC/network config and the lead infra engineer).

I'm attaching a short pre-call checklist and a placeholder network diagram you shared during discovery — if you can drop any additional topology notes into the checklist before the call that will speed things up.

Thanks — Stephanie

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: redwood-ops-precall-checklist.pdf (1 page), orintech-network-diagram-v1.png (image)

From: Alice Moore <alice@orintech.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@orintech.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T12:46:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Ops & Architecture — confirm engineer roster + two slot options

Hi Stephanie — thanks for the quick follow-up and the checklist. Both Tom (infrastructure lead) and I are available, but we have a couple of constraints to call out:

- We have a recurring exec briefing Tue 11:00–11:30 that makes Option A tight for Tom. He could join 11:30–12:15 but prefers Option B.
- We’d like to add a short (5–10m) segment on how Redwood handles KV cache persistence during pod restarts — Tom will want to see the recovery semantics.
- Our lead security engineer (contractor) can join if you need to review port openings / certificate exchange.

Option B looks cleaner for us. Can you confirm if Ben or one of your infra folks can cover KV cache behavior and a quick sketch of failover? Also, timezone note: Tom is on Pacific; I’m on Mountain (but will join PT times you listed).

Thanks,
Alice

--
Alice Moore
Director of Platform Engineering | OrinTech
alice@orintech.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moore <alice@orintech.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-13T13:10:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Ops & Architecture — confirm engineer roster + two slot options

Hi Alice — thanks for the heads up. I can cover KV cache persistence and failure/restore semantics; I'll prepare a short diagram showing: in-memory KV sharding, persisted checkpoints (S3-compatible), and replay paths on restart.

We can reserve 10–12 minutes for that topic in the agenda. I’ll also bring notes on cold-start latency for quantized models and how that interacts with batching policies.

Confirming Option B: Wed Nov 17, 8:00–8:45 AM PT works for our team.

Ben

--
Ben Carter
Principal Pre-Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Moore <alice@orintech.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Ops & Architecture — confirm engineer roster + two slot options

Adding a quick note on logistics: we’ll propose the following calendar and access prep – please confirm before I send the invite.

- Meeting link: Zoom (internal breakout rooms available)
- Proposed invite title: Redwood · OrinTech — Ops & Serving Deep-dive (45m)
- Pre-call doc (shared): https://app.redwood.ai/sched/RDW-3742 (I'll attach the pre-call checklist to the invite)
- Required attendee list: Alice Moore (OrinTech), Tom Delgado (OrinTech), security contractor (optional), Stephanie Nguyen (Redwood), Ben Carter (Redwood), Karthik Iyer (Redwood)

Also: Tom — if you can confirm whether your VPC egress is NATed through a single IP block or through multiple egress points that affects the firewall guidance we'll bring. If it's easier, drop that detail into the pre-call checklist.

If no objections I’ll send the calendar invite for Wed Nov 17, 08:00–08:45 AM PT and attach the two files.

Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Director, Solutions Architecture | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

From: Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@orintech.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-14T15:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Ops & Architecture — confirm engineer roster + two slot options

Thanks — Wed works. Quick answers:
- Egress: our production subnet is behind a NAT gateway with a small, static IP block (3 addresses) — I’ll add the CIDR to the checklist.
- Security contractor will join; she can take the security-specific questions.

Please send the invite; prefer Zoom link in the body and calendar attachment.

Tom
